init.title: ekopiec Configuration
init.description: Choose which entity categories to display

data.show_temperatures: Show Temperature Sensors (11 sensors - boiler, return, DHW, heating circuits)
data.show_climate: Show Heating Circuits - Climate Control (6 circuits with temperature control)
data.show_dhw: Show DHW/CWU Parameters (7 sensors - temperature, pressure, level, runtime)
data.show_switches: Show Output Controls - Pumps, Blower, Valves (8 switches)
data.show_fuel: Show Fuel Management - Level, Runtime, Refuel Date (7 sensors)
data.show_alarms: Show Alarm/Error Status - All system alarms (24 binary sensors)
data.show_numbers: Show Controllable Parameters - Setpoints, Timings (50+ numbers)
data.force_all_circuits: Force create all heating circuits (even if not active in controller)
data.force_all_entities: Create all entities even if data not available (default: ON)
